text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for host gaia-gpu-07 (us-west-2a) — kernel panic / kubelet NotReady. Auto-escalation to oncall.

incident-bot: Alert details: metric=node.heartbeat.missed, reason=kernel_oops, severity=critical, pager=PD#oncall-sre.

tariq: acked. I'm on it — grabbing serial console.

angela: on standby, can help with customer impact assessment. Which tenants are on that rack?

matt: most inference-prod replicas had fallbacks. I see 3 pods on that node: inference-prod-0, batch-embed-1, knn-cache-2. We might have seen elevated tail latencies for route /v1/generate.

sre-lead: quick checklist: cordon + drain if safe, check serial logs for oops, try kubelet restart, check dmesg for Xid errors. If kernel panic recurring -> hardware.

ops: cordon in progress: `kubectl cordon gaia-gpu-07` — done.

ops: starting drain with `kubectl drain gaia-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120`

tariq: serial attached, dumping last 200 lines:
```
[ 1234.567890] NMI: CPU stall
[ 1234.568001] kernel panic - not syncing: Watchdog detected hard LOCKUP
[ 1234.568012] Call Trace:
[ 1234.568020]  <TASK> ... nvme_core_submit_io
[ 1234.568030] Xid 79: GPU HANG detected, GPU driver stacktrace
```

angela: Xid 79 again... sounds similar to last month's rack issue but different host. Are multiple GPUs affected?

tariq: single host, all 8 GPUs appear down; IPMI shows last heartbeat at ~5123456770. Kubelet currently NotReady. Restart attempt: `systemctl restart kubelet` -> timed out.

matt: drain is progressing but 2 pods are stuck in Terminating (rd-cache). Will force-evict if drain doesn't finish in 5m. Customer-facing fallbacks were active, but we'll need to confirm any 5xx spikes.

angela: checking SLO dashboards — small spike in 5xx for tenant acme-corp between 12:05-12:10 UTC. They hit retry logic and saw elevated latency ~1.6s P95. Not widespread but notable.

sre-lead: create an incident ticket and capture timeline. I'll open INC-2026 and add acme-corp tag.

sre-lead: INC-2026 created: "gaia-gpu-07 kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady -> drain/evac handoff". Add links to logs and runbook.

tariq: forced eviction on remaining ones: `kubectl patch pod ...` done. Node emptied of user pods.

ops: attempting reboot via IPMI: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.2.7.18 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle` — IPMI command returned success but host did not come back. Serial console showing immediate oops on boot.

tariq: boot loops with same kernel oops. Given repeated kernel panic on boot, this is likely hardware-level or driver corruption. We'll RMA GPUs and escalate to hardware team.

angela: customer comms: drafting note for the affected tenants — short blurb explaining planned maintenance and any mitigations taken (evacuated nodes, fallback routing). Will ping support to send to acme-corp if needed.

matt: escalation to hw-team: @ops please open RMA ticket and include serial logs + IPMI output.

ops: RMA ticket HW-983 opened, assigned to hw-oncall, priority P1. Included serial dump, Xid logs, dmesg excerpt, and node metadata (BMC logs, asset id).

sre-lead: handoff plan: Tariq will continue hardware coordination for the next 30m, then hand to Angela (next oncall rotation) for follow-ups and postmortem. Schedule on-call handoff in 00:30.

tariq: ack. I'll stay until hardware confirms pickup. If HW requests data, point them to /var/log/serial/gaia-gpu-07-*.log in the ops bucket.

angela: I'll draft post-incident action items: (1) correlate Xid 79 frequency across fleet, (2) add kubelet restart retry guard in runbook, (3) improve fallback routing metrics to surface earlier.

sre-lead: add one operational note: update dedupe rule in paging so repeated kernel oops on same host within 5m auto-group, reduce noise.

matt: marking thread: acknowledged, draining + evicted, RMA open, customers notified. Will update INC-2026 with resolution when RMA complete. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (auto) — incident still tracked in INC-2026 for follow-up.

tariq: handing to angela in 28m. Leaving serial session logs attached to the ticket.

angela: thanks team. I'll take over and coordinate the postmortem and customer follow-ups. Leaving a note in #customer-impact once the support message is sent. :memo:

sre-lead: good job. We'll reconvene in the postmortem channel after HW triage. Closing active paging loop. :v:
